title: Turn on opt-out and unsubscribe settings
blurb: Keep texts and emails within NZ anti-spam rules.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Business Profile
steps.body: Click **Business Profile** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Find the General section
steps.body: Scroll down to the **General** section of Business Profile.

steps.title: SMS opt-out
steps.body: Under **SMS Compliance Settings**, turn on the opt-out message so marketing texts tell people how to stop them (for example "Reply STOP to opt out").

steps.title: Email unsubscribe link
steps.body: Turn on **Make Email compliant by adding an Unsubscribe link in your email**. Luubu then adds an unsubscribe link to your marketing emails.
steps.tip: NZ law (the Unsolicited Electronic Messages Act) needs consent, your business name and a working unsubscribe on every commercial message.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Save the section. These settings apply to everyone in your account.
